Topic

# International English Language Testing System (IELTS)

12 October 2026

International English Language Testing System (IELTS) is proven and trusted worldwide to provide a secure, global, authentic, and customer-focused test. It measures true to life ability to communicate in English. Learn more about International English Language Testing System (IELTS).

HOW TO APPLY

IELTS is proven and trusted worldwide to provide a secure, global, authentic and customer-focused test which measures true to life ability to communicate in English. IELTS is jointly owned by the British Council, IDP:IELTS Australia and Cambridge English Language Assessment. IELTS testing at the University of Canterbury is managed by IDP:IELTS Australia.

IELTS is recognised and accepted by over **13,500** organisations worldwide in over **150** countries, including universities, employers, professional bodies, immigration authorities and other government agencies. In New Zealand, IELTS is used as a measure of English language proficiency for immigration, university entrance requirements and other professional designations.

The cost for the IELTS test is $490 NZD (incl. GST).

**IELTS test Centre Location**

The IELTS Test Centre is located at the Centre for Assessment and Monitoring (CAM) on the Dovedale campus of the University of Canterbury, Christchurch.

Opening hours are 9.30am–4pm, Monday to Friday.

### [Academic or General Training - which do I choose?\  \  \ _keyboard\_arrow\_down_](https://www.canterbury.ac.nz/about-uc/our-structure/faculties/education-faculty/centre-for-assessment-and-monitoring/ielts\#accordion-1cb5d1cad3-item-372b470ce1-button)

There are two IELTS modules to choose from. Both the Academic and General Training modules cover all four (4) language skills (Listening, Reading, Writing and Speaking). The speaking test is an interview with an examiner face to face.

Please click the link to view further information ["Which test should I take"](https://ielts.co.nz/newzealand/prepare/article-which-ielts-test).

###### IELTS Academic

This test is for those who want to study at undergraduate or postgraduate level, and for those seeking professional registration.

###### IELTS General Training

This test is for those who want to migrate to an English-speaking country Australia, Canada, New Zealand, UK) and for those wishing to train or study at below degree level.

_Note: Before you register online for an IELTS test, check with your referring_ organisation _about which test (Academic or General Training) you should select._

### [How to book the IELTS test\  \  \ _keyboard\_arrow\_down_](https://www.canterbury.ac.nz/about-uc/our-structure/faculties/education-faculty/centre-for-assessment-and-monitoring/ielts\#accordion-1cb5d1cad3-item-ce309013bb-button)

Ready to book your IELTS test?

First choose between [IELTS Academic](https://ielts.co.nz/newzealand/about/which-ielts-test/academic) or [IELTS General Training](https://ielts.co.nz/newzealand/about/which-ielts-test/ielts-general-training), depending on your needs.

Then choose your delivery format: [IELTS on computer](https://ielts.co.nz/newzealand/test-dates)

Once you have selected your options, you will select the test dates from the dates available, then you will select the speaking time.

You will then be asked to create an account, or log-in if you already have had an account previously. This is where you will complete the booking and make the payment. A valid debit or credit card will be required to make the payment.  You will need to upload a colour photo of your passport details page also.  Once payment is made, you will instantly receive a booking confirmation email.

The cost for the IELTS test is $490 NZD (incl GST).

### [IELTS test day information\  \  \ _keyboard\_arrow\_down_](https://www.canterbury.ac.nz/about-uc/our-structure/faculties/education-faculty/centre-for-assessment-and-monitoring/ielts\#accordion-1cb5d1cad3-item-15de0b925c-button)

The University of Canterbury offers IELTS on Computer testing.

**IELTS on Computer Tests**

The computer delivered tests are held in the IELTS test centre (Dovedale Ave) on weekdays and some Saturdays. The test will take approximately three hours.

Your speaking interview with an examiner will usually be on the same day as the test. You can select your own interview time, at the time of booking. You will receive a confirmation email immediately after your booking is received. You will receive a further email outlining instructions and directions at least two business days prior to the test.

Results will be available in 1-5 days.

**_Some free parking may be available directly outside of the IELTS test centre on test days._**

**_Free car parking is available on the University of Canterbury, campus on a Saturday, except for parking in reserved, disabled and visitor spaces, or in areas not otherwise marked out for parking._**

**[IELTS Preparation Guide](https://ielts.co.nz/newzealand/prepare/ielts-preparation-guide)**

### [Results – Test Report Form (TRF)\  \  \ _keyboard\_arrow\_down_](https://www.canterbury.ac.nz/about-uc/our-structure/faculties/education-faculty/centre-for-assessment-and-monitoring/ielts\#accordion-1cb5d1cad3-item-173239dca7-button)

**IELTS on Computer Tests**

Your**Computer delivered** test results will be available 1-5 days after your test. You will be notified by email when you have access to download your eTRF.

**Re-marking or Enquiry On Results (EOR)**

If you wish to query your results, an Enquiry on Result can be requested through your own account. There is also an option for a One Skill Retake, if there is just one module that you wish to retake. This can also be requested through your own account.

**Your test will be sent to the head office of IDP Education for re-marking by Senior Examiners.**

_Your result will normally be available in 2 to 21 days, depending on several factors including the number of sections requested for re-mark.  If you have not received a response after 28 days, please contact us._

Please note:

- The fee for an EOR is $240 NZD (incl. GST).
- If there is an increase in your scores, you will be issued with a new updated copy of your test report form (TRF), and you will be eligible for a full refund.
- If there is no change to your scores you will not receive a refund and you will keep your original.
- The fee for an OSR (One Skill Retake), for **IELTS on Computer Tests only** is $310.

### [IELTS cancellation and refund process\  \  \ _keyboard\_arrow\_down_](https://www.canterbury.ac.nz/about-uc/our-structure/faculties/education-faculty/centre-for-assessment-and-monitoring/ielts\#accordion-1cb5d1cad3-item-3f971e04e0-button)

###### Transferring your test date

You can change your test date, module, or format once free of charge, any time up until the day of the test.

If you cannot sit the test on the date that you applied for, please contact us [ielts@canterbury.ac.nz](mailto:ielts@canterbury.ac.nz)

###### Cancellation of your application

**Cancellation policy refund eligibility**

- Cancel 14 days or more before your test and you'll receive a full refund
- Cancel 7 to 13 days before and you'll receive a 50% refund
- Cancel less than 7 days before and unfortunately, no refund applies

[Changes, Cancellation and Refunds Guide](https://ielts.co.nz/newzealand/cancellation-refund-changes)

### [Test day procedure\  \  \ _keyboard\_arrow\_down_](https://www.canterbury.ac.nz/about-uc/our-structure/faculties/education-faculty/centre-for-assessment-and-monitoring/ielts\#accordion-1cb5d1cad3-item-2ed46e572f-button)

Find out what you need to bring and do on the day of your International English Language Testing System test below.

#### Schedule for the day

**IELTS on Computer Test**

Below is an example of a schedule for a typical test day for the **Computer Delivered** test:

- 9:00am - Registration for speaking tests begin.
- 9:20am - First speaking tests start.
- 12:30pm - Registration for Computer Delivered tests begin.
- 12:45pm - The test commences with listening, followed by the reading and writing sections of the test. This takes 2 hours, 45 minutes approximately (with no break).

During the test, your identity will be confirmed and you will be asked to check and confirm your personal details. You are required to check your details carefully and confirm any changes on test day as these details will appear on your Test Report Form.

Your finger scan and photo will be captured on test day. Your test day photo will be used on your Test Report Form.

#### Location

IELTS registration and tests are held at the Dovedale Avenue campus of the University of Canterbury.

We recommend that you allow yourself plenty of time to locate the building and room before your test. Signs will be in place from 9:00am on test day for computer delivered.

What to bring:

- Passport (only those who present passports will be able to take the test).
- Clear water bottle, with the labels removed.
- Food to have during the lunch break, if you are staying on campus between the two tests. There is a cafe available on **weekdays** on campus, if you wish to purchase food in the break between tests.

Do not bring:

- Valuable items (a bag room is available during the exam however the university does not take responsibility for your personal belongings).

If you are unhappy with the service provided on test day then you will be given the opportunity to complete a complaint form at the end of the LWR test.

The IELTS complaints policy is available on [ielts.org](https://www.ielts.org/for-test-takers/ielts-complaints-policy)
